decision: 5 second time penalty (1 penalty points imposed, total of 7 points in the 12 month period)
event_name: Date 12 September 2021 Time 16:41 2021 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 September 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 11 left the track in turn 5 and gained a lasting advantage.
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The stewards reviewed video evidence including in car cameras. Car 11 was attempting to pass Car 16 going into Turn 4. Car 11 turned behind the kerb at Turn 5 and completed the pass by doing so and gained a lasting advantage.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 11 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
